title: What the Sea Otter holds

is_this_you.pressure: When the water turns rough, you find one thing to hold and wrap yourself in it until the swell goes by.
is_this_you.love: You love by staying in reach. You call on the drive home, then once more after you get there.
is_this_you.cost: When hurt, you go under and wait to see who swims back. Some never knew they were meant to.

opener.text: Among the Alutiiq of Kodiak, the Alutiiq Museum tells of a man gathering chitons who was caught by the rising tide, wished to become an otter, and lived [arhnaq]. In that telling, every sea otter came from him [arhnaq]. You were born a Cancer in a Rabbit year. The tide comes in for you as well. It comes in, and it goes out, and you have learned to float.

howto: Three parts. Drift through them in any order.

tabs.label: Holding on
tabs.intro: Water that feeds, Wood that bends.

rows.text: Cancer is cardinal Water, ruled by the Moon, the sign of home, memory and mood [wiki-cancer] [astro-podcast]. The Rabbit is yin Wood, gentle, alert and faithful to the people around it [wiki-cz] [ch-rabbit]. In you the water feeds the wood. You feel first. Then you act, gently, and the care comes out practical.

rows.k: The sea otter does it too
rows.text: A sea otter has no blubber [wiki-otter] [mbay]. Its only coat against the cold is fur, up to about a million hairs to the square inch, and it spends hours every day grooming it [wiki-otter] [mbay]. You keep your people the same way. Small tending, every day, because the tending is the warmth.

The Rabbit steers clear of open conflict and keeps its thoughts hidden [ch-rabbit] [tcg-rabbit]. Cancer pulls back into its shell [wiki-cancer] [astro-podcast]. So when you are hurt, you go under, and the surface looks calm. Say the small thing while it is still small.

Sea otters rest together in single-sex groups called rafts [wiki-otter] [adw]. They wrap themselves in kelp while they rest [adw] [wiki-otter]. Your raft is small, and it is old. You keep the same friends the way an otter keeps its kelp, wound round you, holding you in place.

A newborn pup floats like a cork and cannot dive [wiki-otter] [adw]. When its mother goes down to forage, she sometimes wraps it in kelp first [wiki-otter] [adw]. You know that move. Before you leave anyone, you make sure they are anchored.
Health care, teaching and cooking sit among the Rabbit's traditional fields [ch-rabbit]. Look for work that keeps something fragile in one piece.

tabs.label: Who floats beside you
tabs.intro: Three to rest beside, and one who pulls the other way.
tabs.love_lead: In love you want someone within arm's length. Let them float out a little. The ones worth keeping swim back on their own. Three of the old Chinese pairings float well with you.

easy.why: The Beluga (Pisces, Dog year) is your secret friend, since the Dog is the Rabbit's hidden ally, and Pisces shares your Water [brief] [wiki-cz] [wiki-cancer].
The Snow Leopard (Scorpio, Goat year) sits in your trine of Rabbit, Goat and Pig, with Scorpio's Water close to your own [brief] [wiki-cancer].
The Blue Glaucus (Pisces, Pig year) closes the trine, a fellow Water sign [brief] [wiki-cancer].

hard.why: The current runs against you with the Andean Condor: the Rooster clashes with the Rabbit, and Capricorn sits opposite Cancer [brief] [wiki-cz] [wiki-cancer].

story.text: Alutiiq hunters treated sea otters with care, because otters had once been people [arhnaq]. They gave a killed otter a drink of fresh water and buried or sank its bones, so the otters would come back [arhnaq].

closing: The tide comes in. The tide goes out. You are still here, wrapped in what you chose to keep.
